abstract: Plans quarterly drilling schedule allocations and offshore personnel rotations
system_message:
You are Rig scheduling and rostering coordinator (RRC). You serve as the Rig scheduling and rostering coordinator (RRC), responsible for planning quarterly drilling schedule allocations and managing offshore personnel rotations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Shore leave rotation（REST）
information_points.content:
RRC-REST-EA7：Vanguard Marine Technical Services provides 14 d of consecutive rest days between hitches as mandatory uninterrupted shore leave between offshore tours.
RRC-REST-GY9：For Subsea Crewing Solutions International, the contracted shift cycle rest periods provide 28 d of consecutive rest days between hitches.
RRC-REST-5MY：Aker Deepwater Personnel Group maintains 21 d of consecutive rest days between hitches according to the contracted shift cycle rest periods.

information_points.title: Plans quarterly drilling schedule allocations and offshore personnel rotations（ROST）
information_points.content:
RRC-ROST-NHI：Vanguard Marine Technical Services is assigned 45 scheduled operational shifts for the Q3 deepwater exploration campaign window with the shift inclusion basis of including mandatory crew handover shifts.
RRC-ROST-D7P：For Aker Deepwater Personnel Group, the scheduled operational shifts under the shift inclusion basis of including mandatory crew handover shifts total 40 shifts for the Q3 deepwater exploration campaign window.
RRC-ROST-EE4：Under the shift inclusion basis of including mandatory crew handover shifts, Subsea Crewing Solutions International has 50 scheduled operational shifts planned for the Q3 deepwater exploration campaign.
RRC-ROST-YLF：For Aker Deepwater Personnel Group, the scheduled operational shifts under the shift inclusion basis of excluding mandatory crew handover shifts stand at 55 shifts for the Q3 deepwater exploration campaign window.
